summary_en: Buyback frame expanded from 1.0M shares (¥500M) to 4.0M shares (¥2.0B), 21.0% of shares outstanding. Open-market acquisition on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Period 2026/06/01–12/31. Prior authorization (May 2026): 0 shares acquired as of June 30.
title_en: Notice of Modification – Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Expansion of Acquisition Frame)
translation_en_brief: On July 23, 2026, Abalance Corporation's Board of Directors resolved to expand the treasury stock acquisition frame previously authorized on May 25, 2026. The frame is being enlarged from 1.0 million shares (¥500 million) to 4.0 million shares (¥2.0 billion), representing 21.0% of shares outstanding (computed as 4.0M ÷ 19.0M ex-treasury shares). The acquisition method remains open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with the same execution window of June 1 through December 31, 2026. The Board cited capital-efficiency improvement, enhanced shareholder returns, and the ability to respond flexibly to future changes in the operating environment. As of June 30, 2026, no shares had been acquired under the May authorization. The final disposition (cancellation, treasury, or other use) of acquired shares will be determined based on future business conditions and capital-allocation priorities.
